organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework AI RMF 1.0
supported_use: Lifecycle context, actors and component-risk framing
material_limitations: Voluntary cross-sector framework under revision; does not prescribe this architecture, determine law or certify an implementation

title: Tracing API specification
supported_use: Trace IDs, span IDs, attributes, events and links for correlated technical operations
material_limitations: Observability specification; does not designate governing business records, authorize collection or prove operating outcomes

title: Attribute requirement levels
supported_use: Opt-in treatment for attributes that may be sensitive, expensive or verbose
material_limitations: Technical convention guidance; does not replace privacy, security, records, contractual or legal review

title: GenAI semantic-convention attribute registry
supported_use: Warnings that content-bearing GenAI fields, tool arguments and results may contain sensitive information
material_limitations: Registry is evolving and references migrated conventions; field availability does not authorize production capture

title: Trace Context
supported_use: Trace-correlation fields must not contain personally identifiable or otherwise sensitive information; privacy and trust-boundary considerations
material_limitations: Governs trace-context propagation, not application payloads, self-storage recordkeeping, retention or legal duties

organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: NIST Privacy Framework
supported_use: Data-processing management and data-minimization risk framing
material_limitations: Version 1.0 remains the final cited framework while 1.1 is in development; voluntary and not legal advice

organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations SP 800-53 Rev 5
supported_use: Flexible controls for audit content, access, retention and protection
material_limitations: Federal control catalog; not a self-storage rule, certification, legal conclusion or evidence of compliance
